Refactor RelationForm and RelationService to support multiple target types

- Updated RelationForm to change targetType from a single KRelation.Type to a List<KRelation.Type> in QueryRelationsTargetsSourceIds.
- Modified targets method in RelationService to handle multiple target types by using andIn instead of andEq for querying target types.
- Adjusted TemplateService to accommodate changes in RelationForm and RelationService, ensuring compatibility with the new target types structure.
- Enhanced SQL Template.md to reflect the updated query logic for handling multiple classifications and tags.
